description: This file defines device configurations and build instructions for various hardware targets within an OpenWrt project. It includes macros to generate device-specific images, vendor-specific settings, and build steps, primarily for embedded Linux devices based on IPQ50xx SoC.

methods.name: Build/mstc-header
methods.description: Defines a build macro to generate a device header file with versioning, length, and checksum calculations, involving gzip compression and binary data manipulation.

methods.name: Device/cmcc_pz-l8
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters and build instructions for the CMCC PZ-L8 device, specifying vendor, model, hardware features, and associated build steps.

methods.name: Device/elecom_wrc-x3000gs2
methods.description: Defines build configuration for ELECOM WRC-X3000GS2 device including vendor info, filesystem sizes, and image processing commands.

methods.name: Device/glinet_gl-b3000
methods.description: Configuration macro for GL.iNet GL-B3000 device with details on vendor, hardware specs, images, and packaging.

methods.name: Device/iodata_wn-dax3000gr
methods.description: Build configuration for I-O Data WN-DAX3000GR similar to the other device macros.

methods.name: Device/linksys_ipq50xx_mx_base
methods.description: Base configuration macro for Linksys IPQ50xx devices, with image and size specifications.

methods.name: Device/linksys_mr5500
methods.description: Specific device config for the Linksys MR5500, extending the base macro with device model, DTS config, and packages.

methods.name: Device/linksys_mx6200
methods.description: Configuration macro for Linksys MX6200 with additional image and size settings.

methods.name: Device/linksys_spnmx56
methods.description: Configuration for the Linksys SPNMX56 device.

methods.name: Device/xiaomi_ax6000
methods.description: Configuration macro for Xiaomi AX6000, including specific firmware packages and conditional initramfs artifacts.

methods.name: Device/yuncore_ax830
methods.description: Build configuration for Yuncore AX830 device.

methods.name: Device/yuncore_ax850
methods.description: Build configuration for Yuncore AX850 device.
